permission_note: RIEP confirmed permission to republish the ratings on October 22, 2026.
verification_note: Legislative rows transcribed from all 39 municipal pages and visually checked against the published images. Names matched to RIEP candidate identities using name, chamber and district. Duplicate source entries retained; conflicting labels are displayed without selecting a preferred rating. Absent candidates are not assigned N/A. Source upload directories do not establish candidate-specific update dates.
coverage_note: Covers all 135 published RIEP legislative candidate profiles. Unmatched source rows remain in the separate source audit; no rating is transferred to another candidate in the same district.
